datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Kenya to classify acute food insecurity using the IPC framework. Geographic data with IPC phase classifications and scenario projections were compiled for medium-term forecasting at sub-national administrative units during 2012.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity severity and affected population estimates derived from multi-indicator assessments.
